description: Make the RSVP flow aware of existing per-Guest RSVPs end to end: completed Parties receive a confirmation instead of the RSVP Form, partial Parties answer only for remaining Guests, and the endpoint rechecks live RSVP Sheet state before any append. The short completed state also exposed a PatternWall fill defect that left the page background short of the footer; this slice includes that visual fix.
title: Prevent repeat RSVPs for already-answered Guests
acceptance_criteria: Existing RSVP rows resolve latest-wins by guest_id, and each Party is classified as unanswered, partial, or complete through a testable state interface.
A fully answered Party sees no RSVP Form and receives the confirmed already-received copy with a clickable mailto link to bottarini.ryan@gmail.com for alterations.
A partially answered Party can submit only for unanswered Guests; answered Guests cannot be answered again.
The RSVP endpoint rechecks live state and appends only still-unanswered Guest rows; when nothing remains, it returns already-received success without appending.
First-submission Party fan-out, Plus-one rules, append-only RSVP Sheet history, and Admin latest-wins behavior remain intact.
Automated tests cover unanswered, partial, complete, stale mixed, repeated-completed, and Plus-one cases at state, UI, and endpoint boundaries; the full suite, lint, and type checks pass.
PatternWall fills the available short-page area through the footer and retains the same repeating Home treatment without changing long-page sizing.
content-fidelity and design-reviewer gates pass for the confirmed copy, wall fill, layout, accessibility, and Theme-token use.
root_cause: The RSVP Page loaded the Guest List but not current RSVP Sheet rows, so every Party received a blank form and the endpoint appended without checking answered guest_ids. The newly short completed view also revealed that PatternWall sized only to its content because main was not a flex column and the wall did not grow into the body's remaining height.
fix: Added a latest-wins per-guest_id Party state resolver; complete and partial RSVP rendering; a server-side live-state repeat/stale guard; confirmed already-received alterations copy; state, UI, and endpoint tests; and flex growth on main/PatternWall so short patterned Pages fill to the footer.
notes: Parent specification: GitHub #48. Work and mandatory gates completed locally before Sprint 4 tracking reconciliation; PROCESS.md permits the issue to move straight to shipped.
